items.title: Reuse ARP infrastructure
items.text: Same packet format; only new opcodes and reversed lookup.

items.title: Link-layer only
items.text: No IP routing — client and server share a physical network.

items.title: Broadcast in, unicast out
items.text: Client asks everyone; server answers only the client.

items.title: Server-side database
items.text: A table maps hardware addresses to IP addresses.
